_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.66x; +52% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.29; conservative 2yr +6%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.0%/yr (worst year FY01-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.9%/yr (Q1 2011 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.9%/yr (FY01-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2011-06-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.66x (65.4% downside to Bear $35 / +24.6% upside to Bull $126) | Adj composite 3.10 vs market 2.82: gap +0.29 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +52% above the EPP floor $66 (12x FY11E $5.53) | Conservative 2-yr case: +6.5% total (+3.3%/yr) | At 18.3x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $134 sits above the BULL case; carloads +5% in Q1 2011, forward revenue +13% (no FY11 revenue guide, Q1 2011 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2010 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2006-2010 (diluted EPS 2006 $2.94, 2007 $3.44, 2008 $4.53, 2009 $3.74, 2010 $5.53; 2010 operating ratio 70.6%); 2010 diluted shares 502.9M, effective tax rate 37.3%, interest expense $602M, other income $54M, free cash flow $1,415M; 17,556,522 shares repurchased in 2010; 2011 Outlook in words only (volume to increase from 2010 levels, operating ratio improvement); capital investments of about $3.2 billion

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2006 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2002-2006 (operating revenue, diluted EPS from continuing operations, operating margin and ratio, carloads); 2006 diluted shares 272.0M, effective tax rate 36.4%, interest expense $477M, other income $118M; competition (BNSF parallel routes); 2007 Outlook: commodity revenue growth target 6% to 7%, volume growth 2% to 3%, earnings growth of 10% to 15% and an operating ratio below 80%; quarterly dividend raised to $0.35 on 2007-01-30; 20M-share repurchase authorized 2007-01-30 through 2009

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2007 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2003-2007; 2007 diluted shares 268.4M, effective tax rate 38.4%, interest expense $482M, other income $116M; 2008 Outlook: earnings of $7.75 to $8.25 per diluted share, volume within a range of 1% higher to 1% lower than 2007, fuel prices 15% to 20% above the 2007 average, record revenue and an improved operating ratio in words; capital investments of about $3.1 billion
